Lightweight settings library for .NET. Mark properties with [Save] and persist them with SettingsStore<T>. Thread-safe, saves atomically and falls back to defaults if the file is missing or damaged. It has no file format of its own: use LiteSettings.Xml or plug in your own ISettingsSerializer.
XML format for LiteSettings. Stores [Save] properties in settings.xml under the user’s local application data folder. Install this package to get started, it includes the core LiteSettings library.
